scripts.code: return (function(data, lib){const out={};const y=data.cross['US 10Y yield']||[];const d=data.cross['Dollar index']||[];const yv=y.map(r=>r[1]);const dv=d.map(r=>r[1]);const yRet=yv.length>1?yv[yv.length-1]/yv[yv.length-2]-1:0;const dRet=dv.length>1?dv[dv.length-1]/dv[dv.length-2]-1:0;const score=lib.clamp(-8*yRet-3*dRet,-0.15,0.15);for(const k of ['spx','ndx']){out[k]={h1:lib.clamp(0.5-score,0.3,0.7),close:lib.clamp(0.5-score*0.6,0.3,0.7)};}out.tlt={h1:lib.clamp(0.5-score*0.5,0.3,0.7),close:lib.clamp(0.5+score*0.8,0.3,0.7)};out.boil={h1:0.5,close:lib.clamp(0.5+score*0.3,0.3,0.7)};out.kospi={h1:0.5,close:lib.clamp(0.5-score*0.3,0.3,0.7)};return out;})(data, lib);

scripts.code: return (function(data, lib){const out={};const now=new Date(data.now).getTime()/1000;function p(a){const arr=data.assets[a];const d=arr.daily;const last=d[d.length-1][1];const h=arr.h1;const lh=h[h.length-1];const gap=(lh[1]/last-1);let base=0.5-gap*6;const neg=data.news.filter(n=>/sink|dip|sell off|weaker|worry|worries|drops|falls|disappoint/i.test(n.title)).length;const pos=data.news.filter(n=>/rise|surge|higher|reclaim|beats|strong/i.test(n.title)).length;base+= (pos-neg)*0.004;return lib.clamp(base,0.3,0.7);}for(const a of ['spx','ndx','tlt','boil','kospi']){const v=p(a);out[a]={h1:v,close:v};}return out;})(data, lib);

scripts.description: Fades or follows equity futures when major AI/tech earnings headlines (Alphabet, Amazon, chip names) contradict the prior 3-day trend, using headline polarity and futures drift.
scripts.code: return (function(data, lib){const now=Date.parse(data.now)/1000;const out={};const neg=/(miss|plunge|sell-off|slump|jitters|fears|disappoint|cautious|lower|drop|falls|crash|plunge|weak)/i;const pos=/(beat|surge|rally|strong|record|growth|rise|jump|upgrade|lifts|higher)/i;let score=0,n=0;for(const x of (data.news||[])){const t=x.at?Date.parse(x.at)/1000:now;if(now-t>12*3600)continue;n++;if(neg.test(x.title))score-=1;if(pos.test(x.title))score+=1;}const s=n?lib.clamp(score/Math.max(n,1),-1,1):0;function fut(key){const bars=(data.assets[key]||{}).h1||[];if(bars.length<6)return 0;const c=bars.map(b=>b[1]);const r=(c[c.length-1]-c[c.length-4])/c[c.length-4];return lib.clamp(r*20,-1,1);}for(const k of ['spx','ndx','tlt','boil','kospi']){const f=fut(k);let p=0.5+0.10*f-0.08*s*(k==='tlt'?1:(k==='boil'?0.3:1));out[k]={h1:lib.clamp(p,0.2,0.8),close:lib.clamp(0.5+0.05*f-0.05*s,0.2,0.8)};}return out;})(data, lib);
scripts.author: suggest:deepseek

scripts.description: Fades equity strength after mega-cap AI earnings misses or cautious capex while boosting TLT on yield drop.
scripts.code: const eqShock = (data.news||[]).some(n=>/Alphabet|Amazon|Intel|ServiceNow|AI capex|revenue miss/i.test(n.title)); const yldDrop = (data.cross['US 10Y yield']||[]).slice(-2); const yldDown = yldDrop.length>1 && yldDrop[1][1]<yldDrop[0][1]; return {spx:{h1:eqShock?0.45:0.50,close:eqShock?0.44:0.50},ndx:{h1:eqShock?0.44:0.50,close:eqShock?0.43:0.50},tlt:{h1:yldDown?0.55:0.50,close:yldDown?0.56:0.50},boil:{h1:0.48,close:0.47},kospi:{h1:eqShock?0.47:0.50,close:eqShock?0.46:0.50}};
